>_ OpenAI Codex (v0.161.0)
     ~\work

  To get started, describe a task or try one of these commands:

  /init - create an AGENTS.md file with instructions for Codex
  /status - show current session configuration
  /permissions - choose what Codex is allowed to do
  /model - choose what model and reasoning effort to use
  /review - review any changes and find issues

  Update Model Permissions

› 1. Read Only (current)  Read workspace files, with approval required for edits or internet access
  2. Ask for approval     Read and edit workspace files and run commands, with approval required for internet access or
                          edits outside the workspace
  3. Approve for me       Only ask for actions detected as potentially unsafe
  4. Full Access          Use with caution: Codex can edit files outside this workspace and access the internet without
                          approval

  enter select · esc back
